## Overview

### AWS Backend Development & Serverless API Services by Business Compass LLC

Business Compass LLC is an AWS Advanced Consulting Partner and AWS Well-Architected Framework Partner with50+ AWS certifications across Solution Architect Professional, Developer Professional, Network Specialty, ML Specialty, Gen AI Specialty, and Data Engineer tracks. We specialize in building production-grade serverless backends and APIs for organizations in financial services, media, healthcare, power, and public sector industries.

### Who This Service Is For

This engagement is designed for mid-market and enterprise teams that need to:

* Modernize monolithic backends into serverless microservices
* Build new API layers to support web, mobile, or IoT applications
* Deploy serverless video-on-demand or live streaming backends
* Integrate AI/ML workloads into existing application architectures
* Reduce infrastructure costs and operational overhead through serverless adoption

### Engagement Phases and Deliverables

Phase 1 - Discovery and Architecture Design (1-2 weeks)

* Requirements gathering and stakeholder interviews
* Current-state architecture assessment
* Target-state architecture design document aligned to the AWS Well-Architected Framework
* Deliverable: Architecture design document with cost estimates

Phase 2 - Implementation and Development (2-8 weeks)

* API development using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and supporting services
* Database design and deployment (DynamoDB, RDS, or both)
* Integration with AWS Transfer Family, AWS Glue, or other services as needed
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates for repeatable deployments
* Deliverable: Deployed API endpoints, source code repository, IaC templates

Phase 3 - Testing and Optimization (1-2 weeks)

* Load testing and performance optimization
* Security review and IAM policy hardening
* Monitoring and alerting configuration via CloudWatch
* Deliverable: Test results report, monitoring dashboards, runbook

Phase 4 - Handoff and Knowledge Transfer (1 week)

* Documentation of all deployed services and configurations
* Knowledge transfer sessions with your team
* Deliverable: Operations documentation, CI/CD pipeline, recorded training session

### Use Case Example: Serverless Video-on-Demand Pipeline

Business Compass LLC has deployed serverless video-on-demand and live streaming backends on AWS. A typical engagement involves ingesting video content through AWS Transfer Family, processing it via Lambda-based transcoding workflows, storing assets in S3, and serving them through API Gateway endpoints - all without managing servers, enabling elastic scaling during traffic spikes while minimizing costs during quiet periods.

### Security and Compliance Practices

We build to compliance standards including HIPAA, PCI DSS, NIST 800, and SOC 2. Every engagement follows these security practices:

* Least-privilege IAM policies for all service roles
* Encryption at rest (KMS) and in transit (TLS) for all data paths
* Secrets management via AWS Secrets Manager or Parameter Store
* Access to your AWS environment is scoped, audited, and revoked at engagement close
* VPC isolation and security group hardening where applicable

### Prerequisites and Scope Boundaries

Prerequisites:

* Active AWS account with billing configured
* Designated technical point of contact with admin-level access
* Defined API requirements or existing specification documents

Assumptions:

* Scope covers up to the number of API endpoints agreed during discovery
* Client provides timely feedback during review cycles

Out of Scope (unless separately agreed):

* Frontend or mobile application development
* Data migration from non-AWS sources
* Ongoing managed services post-handoff

### AWS Technologies

AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon RDS, AWS Transfer Family, AWS Glue, Amazon QuickSight, AWS Graviton, Amazon CloudWatch, AWS IAM, AWS KMS, and AWS CloudFormation.

Schedule a discovery call to discuss your backend requirements and receive a scoped proposal tailored to your workload.

### Highlights

* AWS Advanced Consulting Partner with 50+ AWS certifications including Solution Architect Professional, ML Specialty, Gen AI Specialty, and Data Engineer. We follow the AWS Well-Architected Framework and deliver backends built to HIPAA, PCI DSS, NIST 800, and SOC 2 compliance standards with least-privilege IAM, encryption at rest and in transit, and scoped access controls.
* Structured engagements with clear deliverables: architecture design documents, deployed serverless APIs on Lambda and API Gateway, Infrastructure as Code templates, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring dashboards, operations documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions. Typical engagements span 5-13 weeks from discovery through handoff.
* Proven expertise deploying serverless video-on-demand, live streaming backends, and AI/ML workloads on AWS for financial services, media, healthcare, power, and public sector organizations. We modernize monolithic applications into event-driven microservices that scale elastically and reduce infrastructure operational costs.
